drawer.title: Company guide
drawer.noResult: No action matches. Try another word.

denied.title: Missing right
denied.body: You need the "{{right}}" right. A company admin can grant it to you.

end.missing: This screen changed since the guide was written. Open it by hand.

empty.noMember: There is nobody else but you yet.
empty.noReport: No report yet: the first one is generated at midnight.
empty.noTrash: The bin is empty: nothing to restore for now.
empty.noOneToAdd: Every member is already in this team: nobody left to add.
empty.noProjectTeam: This project belongs to no team: the whole company already sees it.
empty.noTeamProject: This team has no project yet: no workload to spread for now.

create.label: Create a project
create.b1: The project name, visible to the whole audience you choose.
create.b2: The owner team decides who leads and manages the project.
create.b3: The due date feeds the timeline and triggers late alerts.

fromTemplate.label: Create a project from a template
fromTemplate.synonyms: template, preset, duplicate, blueprint, standard project
fromTemplate.b1: Pick the template closest to the project you want to start.
fromTemplate.b2: The template's tasks are added here; you can remove some before creating.

audience.label: Manage a project's visibility
audience.b1: These teams also see the project and its tasks, on top of the main team.
audience.b2: Adding a team opens the project to it; you are asked to confirm.

create.label: Create a team task
create.synonyms: new task, ticket, to-do, action item, todo
create.b1: The title says in a few words what needs to be done.
create.b2: The project ties the task to its context and its audience.
create.b3: Assignees receive the task along with a notification.

assign.label: Assign a task
assign.b1: Assignees are the people who must actually do the task.
assign.b2: "Follow" sends you its status changes without assigning you the task.

subtaskDependency.label: Add a subtask or a dependency
subtaskDependency.synonyms: subtask, dependency, blocker, step, break down
subtaskDependency.b1: Add a subtask to split the work into short steps.
subtaskDependency.b2: A blocking task must be finished before this one can move forward.

create.label: Create a task list
create.b1: The list name says what it groups, in a few words.
create.b2: The color sets the list apart in the bar; one click moves to the next one.

restore.label: Restore from the trash
restore.b1: Each deleted item stays visible here, with who deleted it and when.
restore.b2: Restored items come back as they were; after the delay, they are purged.

create.label: Create a team
create.synonyms: new team, group, department, squad, unit
create.b1: The team name appears everywhere the team is mentioned.
create.b2: Tick the starting members; the crown marks the lead, who manages the team.

addMembers.label: Add members to a team
addMembers.b1: Tick several people at once to add them together.

workload.label: See the team workload
workload.b1: Each row shows the work currently on each member's plate.
workload.b2: The colors split work into late, this week, later and no date.

inviteEmail.label: Invite by email
inviteEmail.synonyms: invite, email, mail, add a person, onboard
inviteEmail.b1: Enter one or more addresses, separated by a comma or a new line.
inviteEmail.b2: Each address gets a personal link; the next step sets the starting role.

inviteLink.label: Share a link or a code
inviteLink.b1: Generate an invite link, then copy it and send it through the channel of your choice.
inviteLink.b2: The code lets people join by hand, without opening a link.

joinRequest.label: Accept a join request
joinRequest.b1: Check who is asking to join before you answer.
joinRequest.b2: Accepting opens access to the company; declining closes the request.

offboard.label: Remove a member
offboard.synonyms: remove, leave, offboarding, delete a member, exclude
offboard.b1: This block lists what the person leaves behind; for each item, you choose who takes it over.
offboard.b2: Then choose what happens next: hand over only, suspend, or remove from the company.

permissions.label: Set a member's permissions
permissions.synonyms: permissions, override, individual rights, exception, member
permissions.b1: An override replaces the default right for this one member only.
permissions.b2: "Reset everything to default" gives this member the rights of their role back.

place.label: Place a member in the org chart
place.synonyms: org chart, pyramid, hierarchy, manager, reports to
place.b1: The chosen superior becomes the person's direct manager.
place.b2: This choice decides who can see this person's tasks and work.

create.label: Create a custom role
create.b1: Give the role a name the whole team will understand.
create.b2: The rights matrix lists what the role allows people to do.
create.b3: The color helps you spot the role in member lists.

edit.label: Edit a role
edit.synonyms: edit a role, change rights, adjust, update, permissions
edit.b1: Ticked rights apply to every member who holds this role.
edit.b2: An active role overrides individual settings, and several roles add up.

assign.label: Assign a role
assign.synonyms: assign, give a role, grant, rights, allocate
assign.b1: Pick the role you want to give this member.
assign.b2: Roles already active stay: several roles add up.

assignTimed.label: Give a role for a limited time
assignTimed.synonyms: limited time, temporary, expiry, deadline, interim
assignTimed.b1: The end date says until when the role stays active.
assignTimed.b2: The summary says until when the role applies; on that date, it is removed automatically.

permissions.label: See my own rights
permissions.synonyms: my rights, my permissions, what I can do, access, role
permissions.b1: Active rights list what you can do inside the company.
permissions.b2: Each right shows where it comes from: admin status, your role's default, or a setting made for you.

transferOwnership.label: Transfer ownership
transferOwnership.synonyms: owner, transfer, hand over, give away, ownership
transferOwnership.b1: Choose the person who will become the company owner.
transferOwnership.b2: Billing moves to the new owner; only they can transfer ownership again afterwards.

profile.label: Edit the company profile
profile.b1: The company name is shown to every member.
profile.b2: The logo shows next to the company name.
profile.b3: The description sums up what the company does, shown on its profile.

create.label: Create a company OKR
create.synonyms: OKR, objective, key result, goal, ambition
create.b1: The objective says where the company wants to go, in one sentence.
create.b2: Key results measure concretely whether the objective is reached.
create.b3: The audience decides who sees this objective and can contribute.

update.label: Update a key result
update.synonyms: update, progress, check-in, KR, enter a value
update.b1: The new value replaces the old one and moves the progress.
update.b2: The counter and the bar show where the key result stands against its target.

weekly.label: Start the weekly review
weekly.synonyms: review, weekly, weekly check-in, recap, weekly
weekly.b1: How many tasks were finished this week, compared with last week.
weekly.b2: Deadlines pushed back over the last two weeks, to be settled.

view.label: View an activity report
view.b1: The period shows the dates this report covers.
view.b2: The scope picks the whole company or one of your teams.

export.label: Export tasks
export.b1: The export gathers every company task into a CSV file you can open in a spreadsheet.
